outcome: perinatal complications (pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal complications)
cohort: The study included all women in Ontario, Canada, from 2005 to 2015 with a singleton live birth and no recent history of mental illness during or 2 years before pregnancy.
finding: Chronic disease was associated with an increased risk of postpartum mental illness (aRR 1.15), but perinatal complications showed no clinically meaningful mediating effect, explaining only 1.5% of this association.
